summary: A local dignitary who remembers an earlier campaign objects when a new appearance rule applies.
realLife: Stowe described friction on the 1952 trip when returning political guests expected the access they remembered from 1948; the later trip kept guests off the speaking platform and left intervals for work or rest.
inGame: needs: previous relationship and this campaign's appearance rules.
